description: This file defines the abstract class ReceiverInputDStream for Spark Streaming, which manages data reception via receivers on worker nodes, including rate control and block creation logic.

classes.name: ReceiverInputDStream
classes.description: Abstract class for input streams that receive data via a receiver on worker nodes, handling rate control and block management.

classes.name: ReceiverRateController
classes.description: Inner class that manages rate updates to receivers via the receiver tracker.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the receiver object that will be sent to worker nodes.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Method to start the input stream; empty as start logic is managed elsewhere.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Method to stop the input stream; empty as stop logic is managed elsewhere.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Generates RDDs with blocks received by the receiver for a given batch time.

methods.name: createBlockRDD
methods.description: Creates an RDD from received block information, handling WAL-backed and regular block RDDs.
